features: Dir now owns a branded destructible native handle backed by real directory descriptors, streaming iterators and configured entry buffering. Reads preserve opened identity across rename/replacement; recursive children open relative to parent descriptors. Buffer names/paths and file-URL validation are retained.

Open/read/close run through native filesystem tasks with Strong roots, resource hooks, worker admission/barriers and cancellation cleanup. Explicit close, iteration exit, collection and worker shutdown retire descriptors. Native allocation accounting participates in GC; abandoned collection emits its warning later through the live context identifier.

Async byte paths are copied before scheduling work. Controls verify actual OS descriptors via lsof, buffer encodings, recursion, symlinks, concurrent-operation errors, collection warning and teardown. Public read/close callback delivery remains its existing implementation.

Native configuration declares untracked SDK/directory observations through the supported build API. The pinned maker leaves metadata/directory dependency handling unimplemented; automatic missing/restored/removed controls now pass. Compile command contents are registered as configuration inputs.

The exact WebKit release was restored after cache disappearance and verified against its GitHub release SHA256 ae64fc6fdddca17a7cb06e247b02d692781182f9fe31c35aaeb66860d5dd1687. ProcessBindingFs class header remains byte-identical; no pinned GlobalObject/BunClientData layout or JS2Native ID changes.
limitations: All-platform, Windows ownership and Release/ASAN verification remain open. Full read callback exception/receiver and directory/glob resource grouping semantics remain #878/#877. This implements owned directory streams but does not close every acceptance item.

Node reference required canonical macOS lsof paths and no deprecated Dirent.path assertion. Node itself fails recursive traversal after its root path is renamed; that rejected reference expectation is retained. Ordinary recursion is verified against Node, while recursive rename behavior relies on relative native descriptors and remains a separate parity consideration.

Seventeen final original invocations have 119 passes, twelve process checks and two unchanged upstream TODOs: direct-stream cancellation and WebSocket client context. Neither TODO receives pass credit; full Bun-suite parity is not established.

Initial compilation, missing SDK/stale configuration, incorrect reference assumptions, ineffective metadata/directory cache dependencies and the explicit bufferSize:null regression remain retained. Final originals pass unchanged after the validation fix. All 120 retained reports include 23 expected negative outcomes, including the first failed opendir process.

General Promise/native producer work #877, context frames #871/#856, corpus #876, performance #869/#873/#874/#872 and HTTPS #875/#532 remain open. Earlier excluded constructor/Deno regressions were not rerun. Broad ABI suite was not rerun; the fourteen targeted ABI controls and five Zig checks pass.
Pickier retains three preexisting prefer-const errors and one quote warning, reproduced on the committed baseline; the new native test has no added lint findings.
